_comment: Character models (prototype). Each body keeps the mannequin as an invisible animation driver; the model listed here copies its pose through an IK Retargeter (Tools/build_retargeters.py builds IK_<key> and RTG_Manny_<key> in /Game/WWO/Retarget; rerun it after adding a model). Keys: the flora ids for the player, allies and the character preview, and soldier / swarm / tank for the enemies. scale: the model's size against the mannequin it follows (1 = as authored). hide_slots: material slots to hide (the Paragon heroes' own guns, VeilSpore's cape and cloth proxy). grafts: keep the procedural flora grafts on top (off: the model is the flora's look). Packs come from Fab (see HANDOFF) and are not in git. Edit and restart the game; no build needed unless you add a model (then rerun the script).
